operators.name: maxpool2d_forward
semantics: Performs 2D max pooling with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=(2,2), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Matches nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=(2,2)) default configuration in model.py.
Input tensor x is on CUDA and float32; output tensor is on CUDA and float32 with shape [64,3,512,512].

operators.name: leaky_relu_forward
semantics: Applies leaky ReLU elementwise: output = x if x >= 0 else negative_slope * x.
Input and output are CUDA float32 tensors with same shape.
Calls self.maxpool on input x; max pooling with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=(2,2), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Result is CUDA float32 tensor with shape [64,3,512,512].
Applies leaky ReLU with negative_slope=0.01 elementwise on x.
